fields.name: IsHotspot
fields.title: Is Hotspot
fields.description: If 'true', the device treats the network as a hotspot.

fields.name: SSID_STR
fields.title: Service Set Identifier (SSID)
fields.description: The SSID of the Wi-Fi network to use. In iOS 7.0 and later, the SSID is optional if a value exists for 'DomainName' value.

fields.name: HIDDEN_NETWORK
fields.title: Hidden Network
fields.description: If 'true', defines this network as hidden.

fields.name: AutoJoin
fields.title: Auto Join
fields.description: If 'true', the device joins the network automatically. If 'false', the user must tap the network name to join it.

fields.name: CaptiveBypass
fields.title: Disable Captive Network Detection
fields.description: If 'true', the system bypasses Captive Network detection when the device connects to the network.

fields.name: DisableAssociationMACRandomization
fields.title: Disable MAC address randomization during association
fields.description: If 'true,' disables MAC address randomization for a Wi-Fi network while associated with that network. This feature also shows a privacy warning in Settings indicating that the network has reduced privacy protections. If 'false', then the system enables MAC address randomization o…

fields.name: EnableIPv6
fields.title: Enable IPv6
fields.description: If 'true', enables IPv6 on this interface.

fields.name: ProxyType
fields.title: Proxy Type
fields.description: The proxy type, if any, to use. If you choose the manual proxy type, you need the proxy server address, including its port and optionally a user name and password into the proxy server. If you choose the auto proxy type, you can enter a proxy autoconfiguration (PAC) URL.

fields.name: ProxyServer
fields.title: Proxy Server
fields.description: The proxy server's network address.

fields.name: ProxyServerPort
fields.title: Proxy Server Port
fields.description: The proxy server's port number.

fields.name: ProxyUsername
fields.title: Proxy Username
fields.description: The user name used to authenticate to the proxy server.

fields.name: ProxyPassword
fields.title: Proxy Password
fields.description: The password used to authenticate to the proxy server.

fields.name: ProxyPACURL
fields.title: Proxy PAC URL
fields.description: The URL of the PAC file that defines the proxy configuration.

fields.name: ProxyPACFallbackAllowed
fields.title: Proxy PAC Fallback Allowed
fields.description: If 'true', allows connecting directly to the destination if the PAC file is unreachable.

fields.name: EncryptionType
fields.title: Encryption Type
fields.description: The encryption type for the network. If set to anything except 'None', the payload may contain the following three keys: 'Password', 'PayloadCertificateUUID', or 'EAPClientConfiguration'. As of iOS 16, tvOS 16, watchOS 9, and macOS 13: - 'WPA' allows joining WPA or WPA2 networks …

fields.name: Password
fields.title: Password
fields.description: The password for the access point.

fields.name: DisplayedOperatorName
fields.title: Displayed Operator Name
fields.description: The operator name to display when connected to this network. Used only with Wi-Fi Hotspot 2.0 access points.

fields.name: DomainName
fields.title: Domain Name
fields.description: The primary domain of the tunnel.

fields.name: ServiceProviderRoamingEnabled
fields.title: Roaming Enable
fields.description: If 'true', allows connection to roaming service providers.

fields.name: RoamingConsortiumOIs
fields.title: Roaming OIs
fields.description: An array of Roaming Consortium Organization Identifiers used for Wi-Fi Hotspot 2.0 negotiation.

fields.name: NAIRealmNames
fields.title: Realm Names
fields.description: An array of Network Access Identifier Realm names used for Wi-Fi Hotspot 2.0 negotiation.

fields.name: MCCAndMNCs
fields.title: MCC/MNCs
fields.description: An array of Mobile Country Code/Mobile Network Code (MCC/MNC) pairs used for Wi-Fi Hotspot 2.0 negotiation. Each string must contain exactly six digits.

fields.name: HESSID
fields.title: Homogenous Extended Service Set Identifier (HESSID)
fields.description: The HESSID used for Wi-Fi Hotspot 2.0 negotiation.

fields.name: SetupModes
fields.title: EAP Setup Modes
fields.description: An array of strings that contain the type of connection mode to attach.

fields.name: EAPClientConfiguration
fields.title: EAP Client Configuration
fields.description: The enterprise network configuration.

fields.name: QoSMarkingPolicy
fields.title: QoS Marking Policy
fields.description: A dictionary that contains the list of apps that the system allows to benefit from L2 and L3 marking. When this dictionary isn't present, the system allows all apps to use L2 and L3 marking when the Wi-Fi network supports Cisco QoS fast lane.

fields.name: PayloadCertificateUUID
fields.title: Certificate UUID
fields.description: The UUID of the certificate payload within the same profile to use for the client credential.

fields.name: TLSCertificateRequired
fields.title: Certificate Required
fields.description: If 'true', allows for two-factor authentication for EAP-TTLS, PEAP, or EAP-FAST. If 'false', allows for zero-factor authentication for EAP-TLS.

fields.name: allowCamera
fields.title: Allow Camera Use
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables the camera and removes its icon from the Home Screen, and users are unable to take photographs. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

fields.name: allowedCameraRestrictionBundleIDs
fields.title: Allowed Exceptions to Camera Restriction
fields.description: If present, the system exempts apps with bundle IDs in the array from the 'allowCamera' restriction. The system doesn't grant these apps access to the camera automatically; they're only exempted from the 'allowCamera' restriction. This key has no effect when the camera isn't rest…

fields.name: allowVideoConferencing
fields.title: Allow Video Conferencing
fields.description: If 'false', the system hides the FaceTime app. Requires a supervised device in iOS 13 and later.

fields.name: allowCloudBackup
fields.title: Allow iCloud Backup
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables backing up the device to iCloud. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

fields.name: allowCloudPhotoLibrary
fields.title: Allow iCloud Photo Library
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables iCloud Photo Library. The system removes any photos from local storage that aren't fully downloaded from iCloud Photo Library to the device. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices and with Managed Apple Accounts is deprecated.

fields.name: allowPhotoStream
fields.title: Allow Photo Stream
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables Photo Stream.

fields.name: allowSharedStream
fields.title: Allow Shared Stream
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables Shared Photo Stream. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

fields.name: allowPasswordAutoFill
fields.title: Allow password AutoFill
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables: - The AutoFill Passwords feature in iOS, with Keychain and third-party password managers - Prompting the user to use a saved password in Safari or in apps - Automatic strong passwords - Suggesting strong passwords to users However, if 'false', the…

fields.name: allowAutoUnlock
fields.title: Allow Apple Watch to auto unlock device
fields.description: If 'false', the system disallows auto unlock. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

fields.name: allowFingerprintForUnlock
fields.title: Allow Touch ID to Unlock Device
fields.description: If 'false', the system prevents Touch ID, Face ID, or Optic ID from unlocking a device. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

fields.name: allowBookstore
fields.title: Allow Bookstore
fields.description: If 'false', the system removes the Book Store tab from the Books app.

fields.name: allowChat
fields.title: Allow use of iMessage
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables the use of iMessage with supervised devices. If the device supports text messaging, the user can still send and receive text messages.

fields.name: allowiTunes
fields.title: Allow use of iTunes
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables the iTunes Music Store and removes its icon from the Home Screen. Users can't preview, purchase, or download content. Requires a supervised device in iOS 13 and later.

fields.name: allowMusicService
fields.title: Allow Apple Music
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables the Music service, and the Music app reverts to classic mode.

fields.name: allowNews
fields.title: Allow use of News
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables News.

fields.name: allowPodcasts
fields.title: Allow Podcasts
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables podcasts.

fields.name: allowRadioService
fields.title: Allow iTunes Radio
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables Apple Music Radio.

fields.name: allowYouTube
fields.title: Allow Apple's YouTube
fields.description: This key is ignored on iOS 6 and later because the YouTube app is no longer built in.

fields.name: allowAppsToBeHidden
fields.title: Allow Hiding Apps
fields.description: If 'false', disables the ability for the user to hide apps. It doesn't affect the user's ability to leave it in the App Library, while removing it from the Home Screen.

fields.name: allowAppsToBeLocked
fields.title: Allow Locking Apps
fields.description: If 'false', disables the ability for the user to lock apps. Because hiding apps also requires locking them, disallowing locking also disallows hiding.

fields.name: allowCloudDocumentSync
fields.title: Allow iCloud Document Sync
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables document and key-value syncing to iCloud. Requires a supervised device in iOS 13 and later, and Shared iPad doesn't support it. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices and with Managed Apple Accounts is deprecated.

fields.name: allowCloudKeychainSync
fields.title: Allow iCloud Keychain
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables iCloud Keychain synchronization. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices and with Managed Apple Accounts is deprecated.

fields.name: allowDefinitionLookup
fields.title: Allow definition lookup
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables definition lookup.

fields.name: allowDeprecatedWebKitTLS
fields.title: Allow accessing websites using TLS 1.0 and 1.1
fields.description: Allow websites that use TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1 to be accessed using Safari.

fields.name: allowAirPrint
fields.title: Allow AirPrint
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables AirPrint.

fields.name: allowAirPrintiBeaconDiscovery
fields.title: Allow discovery of AirPrint printers using iBeacons
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables iBeacon discovery of AirPrint printers, which prevents spurious AirPrint Bluetooth beacons from phishing for network traffic.

fields.name: forceAirPrintTrustedTLSRequirement
fields.title: Disallow AirPrint to destinations with untrusted certificates
fields.description: If 'true', the system requires trusted certificates for TLS printing communication.

fields.name: allowScreenShot
fields.title: Allow Screenshots and Screen Recording
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables saving a screenshot of the display and capturing a screen recording. It also disables the Classroom app from observing remote screens.

fields.name: allowRemoteScreenObservation
fields.title: Allow Remote Screen Observation
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables remote screen observation by the Classroom app. Nest this key beneath 'allowScreenShot' as a subrestriction. If 'allowScreenShot' is 'false', the Classroom app doesn't observe remote screens. Requires a supervised device until iOS 13 and macOS 10.1…

fields.name: forceClassroomUnpromptedScreenObservation
fields.title: Allow Classroom app to perform AirPlay and View Screen without prompting
fields.description: If 'true' and 'ScreenObservationPermissionModificationAllowed' is also 'true' in the Education payload, a student enrolled in a managed course through the Classroom app automatically gives permission to that course teacher's requests to observe the student's screen without prompt…

fields.name: forceUnpromptedManagedClassroomScreenObservation
fields.title: forceUnpromptedManagedClassroomScreenObservation
fields.description: Deprecated in iOS 11. Use forceClassroomUnpromptedScreenObservation instead.

fields.name: allowVoiceDialing
fields.title: Allow Voice Dialing While Device is Locked
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables voice dialing if the device is locked with a passcode.

fields.name: allowAssistant
fields.title: Allow Siri
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables Siri.

fields.name: allowAssistantWhileLocked
fields.title: Allow Siri While Locked
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables Siri when the device is locked. The system ignores this restriction if the device doesn't have a passcode set.

fields.name: forceAssistantProfanityFilter
fields.title: Enable Siri Profanity Filter
fields.description: If 'true', the system forces the use of the profanity filter for Siri and dictation. Requires a supervised device in iOS.

fields.name: allowAssistantUserGeneratedContent
fields.title: Show user-generated content in Siri
fields.description: If 'false', the system prevents Siri from querying user-generated content from the web.

fields.name: allowSiriServerLogging
fields.title: Allow server-side logging of Siri commands
fields.description: Allow server-side logging of Siri commands

fields.name: allowSpotlightInternetResults
fields.title: Allow Siri Suggestions
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables Spotlight Internet search results in Siri Suggestions. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

fields.name: allowAppInstallation
fields.title: Allow App Installation
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables the App Store and removes its icon from the Home Screen. Users are unable to install or update their apps. This applies to App Store apps, marketplace apps, and locally installed apps (using Configurator, Xcode, and so forth). In iOS 10 and later, …

fields.name: allowUIAppInstallation
fields.title: Allow App Installation from App Store
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables the App Store and removes its icon from the Home Screen. However, users can continue to install or update their apps either locally (via Configurator, Xcode, and so forth), or using alternative marketplace apps. In iOS 10 and later, MDM commands ca…

fields.name: allowAutomaticAppDownloads
fields.title: Allow Automatic App Downloads
fields.description: If 'false', the system prevents automatic downloading of apps purchased on other devices. This setting doesn't affect updates to existing apps.

fields.name: allowMarketplaceAppInstallation
fields.title: Allow App Installation from alternative marketplaces
fields.description: If 'false', the system prevents installation of alternative marketplace apps from the web and prevents any installed alternative marketplace apps from installing apps.

fields.name: allowWebDistributionAppInstallation
fields.title: Allow App Installation from web sites
fields.description: If 'false', the device prevents installation of apps directly from the web.

fields.name: allowAppRemoval
fields.title: Allow App Removal
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables removal of apps from an iOS device. This applies to App Store apps, marketplace apps, and locally installed apps (using Configurator, Xcode, and so forth).

fields.name: allowAppClips
fields.title: Allow App Clips
fields.description: If 'false', the system prevents a user from adding any App Clips, and removes any existing App Clips on the device.

fields.name: allowSystemAppRemoval
fields.title: Allow removing system apps
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables the removal of system apps from the device.

fields.name: allowInAppPurchases
fields.title: Allow In App Purchases
fields.description: If 'false', the system prohibits in-app purchasing. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

fields.name: forceITunesStorePasswordEntry
fields.title: Require iTunes password for all purchases
fields.description: If 'true', the system forces the user to enter their iTunes password for each transaction.

fields.name: allowManagedAppsCloudSync
fields.title: Allow iCloud Sync for Managed Apps
fields.description: If 'false', the system prevents managed apps from using iCloud sync.

fields.name: allowEnterpriseBookBackup
fields.title: Allow Enterprise Books Backup
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables backup of Enterprise books.

fields.name: allowEnterpriseBookMetadataSync
fields.title: Allow Enterprise Books Notes and Highlights Sync
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables sync of Enterprise books, notes, and highlights.

fields.name: allowCloudPrivateRelay
fields.title: Allow iCloud Private Relay
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables iCloud Private Relay. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices and with Managed Apple Accounts is deprecated.

fields.name: allowGlobalBackgroundFetchWhenRoaming
fields.title: Allow Automatic Sync While Roaming
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables global background fetch activity when an iOS phone is roaming. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

fields.name: forceEncryptedBackup
fields.title: Force Encrypted Backups
fields.description: If 'true', the system encrypts all backups.

fields.name: allowEraseContentAndSettings
fields.title: Allow Erase All Content and Settings
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables the Erase All Content and Settings option in the Reset UI.

fields.name: forcePreserveESIMOnErase
fields.title: Force Preserve ESIM on Erase
fields.description: If 'true', the system preserves eSIM when it erases the device due to too many failed password attempts or the Erase All Content and Settings option in Settings > General > Reset. Note: The system doesn't preserve eSIM if Find My initiates erasing the device.

fields.name: allowUntrustedTLSPrompt
fields.title: Allow user to accept untrusted TLS certificates
fields.description: If 'false', the system automatically rejects untrusted HTTPS certificates without prompting the user.

fields.name: allowEnterpriseAppTrust
fields.title: Allow Trusting Enterprise Apps
fields.description: If 'false', the system removes the Trust Enterprise Developer button in Settings > General > VPN & Device Management, which prevents provisioning apps by universal provisioning profiles. This restriction applies to free developer accounts and enterprise app developers that aren't…

fields.name: allowOTAPKIUpdates
fields.title: Allow automatic updates to certificate trust settings
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables over-the-air PKI updates. Setting this restriction to 'false' doesn't disable CRL and OCSP checks.

fields.name: allowUIConfigurationProfileInstallation
fields.title: Allow UI Configuration Profile Installation
fields.description: If 'false', the system prohibits the user from installing configuration profiles and certificates interactively.

fields.name: allowVPNCreation
fields.title: Allow Adding VPN Configurations (Supervised devices only)
fields.description: If 'false', the system allows only managed apps to create VPN configurations. Prior to iOS 18, the system also allows unmanaged apps to create VPN configurations.

fields.name: forceAutomaticDateAndTime
fields.title: Force automatic date and time
fields.description: If 'true', the system enables the Set Automatically feature in Date & Time and the user can't disable it. The system updates the device's time zone only when the device can determine its location using a cellular connection or Wi-Fi with location services enabled.

fields.name: forceClassroomUnpromptedAppAndDeviceLock
fields.title: Allow Classroom to lock apps or the device without prompting
fields.description: If 'true', the system allows the teacher to lock apps or the device without prompting the student.

fields.name: forceClassroomAutomaticallyJoinClasses
fields.title: Automatically join Classroom classes without prompting
fields.description: If 'true', the system automatically gives permission to the teacher's requests without prompting the student.

fields.name: forceClassroomRequestPermissionToLeaveClasses
fields.title: Require teacher permission to leave Classroom app unmanaged classes
fields.description: If 'true', a student enrolled in an unmanaged course through Classroom needs to request permission from the teacher to leave the course.

fields.name: allowAccountModification
fields.title: Allow modifying account settings
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables modification of accounts, such as Apple Accounts, and internet-based accounts, such as Mail, Contacts, and Calendar.

fields.name: allowBluetoothModification
fields.title: Allow modifying Bluetooth settings
fields.description: If 'false', the system prevents modification of Bluetooth settings.

fields.name: allowAppCellularDataModification
fields.title: Allow Modifying Cellular Data Usage for Apps Settings
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables changing settings for cellular data usage for apps.

fields.name: allowCellularPlanModification
fields.title: Allow modifying celluar plan settings
fields.description: If 'false', the system prevents users from changing settings related to their cellular plan (available only on select carriers).

fields.name: allowESIMModification
fields.title: Allow eSIM Modification
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables modifications of eSIMs.

fields.name: allowFindMyFriendsModification
fields.title: Allow modifying Find My Friends settings
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables changes to Find My Friends.

fields.name: allowNotificationsModification
fields.title: Allow Modifying Notifications Settings
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables modification of notification settings.

fields.name: allowNFC
fields.title: Allow NFC
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables NFC.

fields.name: allowPasscodeModification
fields.title: Allow Modifying Passcode
fields.description: If 'false', the system prevents adding, changing, or removing the passcode. The system ignores this restriction on Shared iPad.

fields.name: allowFingerprintModification
fields.title: Allow modifying Touch ID / Face ID
fields.description: If 'false', the system prevents the user from modifying Touch ID or Face ID.

fields.name: allowEnablingRestrictions
fields.title: Allow Configuring Restrictions or ScreenTime
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables the Enable Restrictions option in the Restrictions UI in Settings. If 'false' in iOS 12 and later, the system disables the Enable ScreenTime option in the ScreenTime UI in Settings and disables ScreenTime if already enabled.

fields.name: allowWallpaperModification
fields.title: Allow Modifying Wallpaper
fields.description: If 'false', the system prevents changing the wallpaper.

fields.name: allowUSBRestrictedMode
fields.title: Allow USB Restricted Mode
fields.description: If 'false', the system allows iOS devices to always connect to USB accessories while locked. In macOS, allows new USB and Thunderbolt accessories, and SD cards to connect without authorization. If the system has Lockdown mode enabled, it ignores this value. This restriction is no…

fields.name: allowHostPairing
fields.title: Allow pairing with non-Configurator hosts
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables host pairing with the exception of the supervision host. If there's no configured supervision host certificate, the system disables all pairing. Host pairing lets the administrator control whether an iOS device can pair with a host Mac or PC.

fields.name: allowiPhoneWidgetsOnMac
fields.title: Allow iPhone widget on Mac
fields.description: If 'false', the system disallows iPhone widgets on a Mac that signs in with the same Apple Account for iCloud.

fields.name: allowUnpairedExternalBootToRecovery
fields.title: Allow booting into recovery by unpaired devices
fields.description: If 'true', the system allows unpaired devices to boot devices into recovery.

fields.name: allowOpenFromManagedToUnmanaged
fields.title: Enable allow open from managed to unmanaged
fields.description: If 'false', documents in managed apps and accounts open only in other managed apps and accounts.

fields.name: allowOpenFromUnmanagedToManaged
fields.title: Enable allow open from unmanaged to managed
fields.description: If 'false', documents in unmanaged apps and accounts open only in other unmanaged apps and accounts.

fields.name: allowUnmanagedToReadManagedContacts
fields.title: Allow unmanaged apps to read managed contacts accounts
fields.description: If 'true', the system allows unmanaged apps to read from managed contacts accounts. If 'allowOpenFromManagedToUnmanaged' is 'true', this restriction has no effect. Important: Use MDM to install profiles that contain this restriction.

fields.name: allowManagedToWriteUnmanagedContacts
fields.title: Allow managed apps to write to managed contacts accounts
fields.description: If 'true', the system allows managed apps to write contacts to unmanaged accounts. If 'allowOpenFromManagedToUnmanaged' is 'true', this restriction has no effect. Important: Use MDM to install profiles that contain this restriction.

fields.name: requireManagedPasteboard
fields.title: Require managed pasteboard
fields.description: If 'true', copy-and-paste functionality is limited by the 'allowOpenFromManagedToUnmanaged' and 'allowOpenFromUnmanagedToManaged' restrictions.

fields.name: allowAirDrop
fields.title: Allow AirDrop
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables AirDrop.

fields.name: forceAirDropUnmanaged
fields.title: Treat AirDrop as Unmanaged Destination
fields.description: If 'true', the system considers AirDrop to be an unmanaged drop target.

fields.name: allowActivityContinuation
fields.title: Allow Handoff
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables activity continuation. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices and with Managed Apple Accounts is deprecated. In a future release, this restriction will begin requiring supervision and will apply to personal Apple Accounts only.

fields.name: allowDiagnosticSubmission
fields.title: Allow diagnostic submission
fields.description: If 'false', the system prevents the device from automatically submitting diagnostic reports to Apple.

fields.name: allowDiagnosticSubmissionModification
fields.title: Allow modifying diagnostics settings
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables changing the diagnostic submission and app analytics settings in the Diagnostics & Usage UI in Settings.

fields.name: forceAuthenticationBeforeAutoFill
fields.title: Require Touch ID / Face ID authentication before Autofill
fields.description: If 'true', the user needs to authenticate before the system can autofill passwords or credit card information in Safari and apps. If this restriction isn't enforced, the user can toggle this feature in Settings. Only supported on devices with Face ID or Touch ID.

fields.name: allowPairedWatch
fields.title: Allow Pairing With Apple Watch
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables pairing with an Apple Watch, and the system unpairs any currently paired Apple Watch and erases its content.

fields.name: forceWatchWristDetection
fields.title: Force Apple Watch Wrist Detection
fields.description: If 'true', the system forces a paired Apple Watch to use Wrist Detection.

fields.name: forceWiFiPowerOn
fields.title: Disallow Wi-Fi from being turned off
fields.description: If 'true', the system prevents turning off Wi-Fi in Settings or Control Center, even by entering or leaving Airplane Mode. It doesn't prevent selecting which Wi-Fi network to use. and later.

fields.name: forceWiFiToAllowedNetworksOnly
fields.title: Join only Wi-Fi networks installed by a Wi-Fi payload
fields.description: If 'true', the system limits the device to only join Wi-Fi networks set up through a configuration profile.

fields.name: forceWiFiWhitelisting
fields.title: Only join Wi-Fi networks installed by profiles
fields.description: Use 'forceWiFiToAllowedNetworksOnly' instead.

fields.name: allowProximitySetupToNewDevice
fields.title: Allow setting up new nearby iOS devices
fields.description: If 'false', disables the prompt to set up new devices that are nearby. Starting with iOS 26.3, this also prevents exporting iOS data to set up new Android devices.

fields.name: allowPredictiveKeyboard
fields.title: Allow Predictive Keyboard
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables predictive keyboards.

fields.name: allowKeyboardShortcuts
fields.title: Allow Keyboard Shortcuts
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables keyboard shortcuts.

fields.name: allowAutoCorrection
fields.title: Allow Auto Correction
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables keyboard autocorrection.

fields.name: allowContinuousPathKeyboard
fields.title: Allow Continuous Path Keyboard
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables QuickPath keyboard.

fields.name: allowSpellCheck
fields.title: Allow Spell Check
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables the keyboard spell checker.

fields.name: allowSharedDeviceTemporarySession
fields.title: Allow Shared iPad temporary session
fields.description: If 'false', the system makes temporary sessions unavailable on Shared iPad.

fields.name: allowDictation
fields.title: Allow dictation
fields.description: If 'false', the system disallows dictation input.

fields.name: forceOnDeviceOnlyDictation
fields.title: Force on-device only dictation
fields.description: If 'true', the system disables connections to Siri servers for the purposes of dictation.

fields.name: forceOnDeviceOnlyTranslation
fields.title: Force on-device only translation
fields.description: If 'true', the device can't connect to Siri servers for the purposes of translation.

fields.name: allowPassbookWhileLocked
fields.title: Allow Wallet While Locked
fields.description: If 'false', the system hides Passbook notifications from the Lock Screen.

fields.name: allowPersonalHotspotModification
fields.title: Allow modifying Personal Hotspot settings
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables modifications of the personal hotspot setting.

fields.name: allowLiveVoicemail
fields.title: Allow Live Voicemail
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables live voicemail on the device.

fields.name: allowLockScreenControlCenter
fields.title: Show Control Center on Lock screen
fields.description: If 'false', the system prevents Control Center from appearing on the Lock Screen.

fields.name: allowLockScreenNotificationsView
fields.title: Show Notification Center on Lock screen
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables the Notifications history view on the Lock Screen, so users can't view past notifications. However, they can still see notifications when they arrive.

fields.name: allowLockScreenTodayView
fields.title: Show Today view on Lock screen
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables the Today view in Notification Center on the Lock Screen.

fields.name: forceAirPlayOutgoingRequestsPairingPassword
fields.title: Require passcode on first AirPlay pairing
fields.description: If 'true', the system forces all devices receiving AirPlay requests from this device to use a pairing password.

fields.name: allowAirPrintCredentialsStorage
fields.title: Allow storage of AirPrint credentials in Keychain
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables Keychain storage of user name and password for AirPrint.

fields.name: forceLimitAdTracking
fields.title: Force limited ad tracking
fields.description: If 'true', the system limits ad tracking. Additionally, it disables app tracking and the Allow Apps to Request to Track setting.

fields.name: allowApplePersonalizedAdvertising
fields.title: Allow Apple-personalized advertizing
fields.description: If 'false', the system limits Apple personalized advertising.

fields.name: allowMailPrivacyProtection
fields.title: Allow mail privacy protection
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables Mail Privacy Protection on the device.

fields.name: allowAutoDim
fields.title: Allow Auto Dim
fields.description: If 'false', disables auto dim on iPads with OLED displays.

fields.name: allowGameCenter
fields.title: Allow Game Center
fields.description: If 'false', the system disables Game Center, and the system removes its icon from the Home Screen.

fields.name: EmailAccountType

fields.description: The full email address for the account. If this string isn't present in the payload, the device prompts the user for this string during interactive profile installation in Settings or System Preferences.

fields.name: PreventMove
fields.title: Allow user to move messages from this account
fields.description: If 'true', the system prevents moving messages out of this email account and into another account. It also prevents forwarding or replying from an account other than the recipient of the message.

fields.name: disableMailRecentsSyncing
fields.title: Allow recent addresses to be synced
fields.description: If 'true', the system excludes this account from Recent Addresses syncing.

fields.name: allowMailDrop
fields.title: Allow Mail Drop
fields.description: If 'true', the system enables this account to use Mail Drop.

fields.name: PreventAppSheet
fields.title: Use Only In Mail
fields.description: If 'true', the system prevents this account from sending mail in any app other than the Apple Mail app.

fields.name: SMIMEEnabled

fields.description: If 'true', the system enables S/MIME encryption. The system ignores this key in iOS 10.0 and later.

fields.name: SMIMESigningEnabled

fields.description: If 'true', the system enables S/MIME signing for this account.

fields.name: SMIMESigningCertificateUUID

fields.name: SMIMEEncryptionEnabled

fields.description: If 'true', the system displays the per-message encryption switch in the Mail Compose UI. Deprecated in iOS 12.0. Use 'SMIMEEnableEncryptionPerMessageSwitch' instead.

fields.name: SMIMESigningUserOverrideable

fields.name: SMIMESigningCertificateUUIDUserOverrideable

fields.name: SMIMEEncryptByDefault

fields.description: If 'true', the system enables S/MIME encryption by default.

fields.name: SMIMEEncryptionCertificateUUIDUserOverrideable
fields.title: Enable user to select the signing identity and encryption is enabled
fields.description: If 'true', the user can select the S/MIME encryption identity, and encryption is on.

fields.name: SMIMEEnableEncryptionPerMessageSwitch
fields.title: Enable per-message encryption switch
fields.description: If 'true', the system displays the per-message encryption switch in the Mail Compose UI.

fields.name: OutgoingMailServerAuthentication
fields.title: Outgoing Mail Server Authentication Type

fields.name: OutgoingPassword
fields.title: Outgoing Mail Server Password
fields.description: The password for the outgoing mail server. Only use this in encrypted profiles.

fields.name: OutgoingPasswordSameAsIncomingPassword
fields.title: Outgoing Password Same As Incoming
fields.description: If 'true', the system prompts the user only once for the password, which it uses for both outgoing and incoming mail. This setting is only supported by interactive profile installations. Not supported by non-interactive installations, such as MDM on iOS.

fields.name: OutgoingMailServerUseSSL
fields.title: Outgoing Mail Server Use SSL
fields.description: If 'true', the system enables SSL authentication on the outgoing mail server.

fields.description: The URL of the web clip.

fields.description: If 'true', the system enables removing the web clip.

fields.name: Precomposed
fields.title: Precomposed Icon
fields.description: If 'true', the system prevents SpringBoard from adding shine to the icon.

fields.name: FullScreen
fields.title: Full Screen
fields.description: If 'true', the system launches the web clip as a full-screen web app.

fields.name: IgnoreManifestScope
fields.title: Ignore Web Clip manifest scope
fields.description: If 'true', a full screen web clip can navigate to an external web site without showing Safari UI. Otherwise, Safari UI appears when navigating away from the web clip's URL. This key has no effect when 'FullScreen' is 'false'. Available in iOS 14 and later.

fields.name: TargetApplicationBundleIdentifier
fields.title: Target Application Bundle Identifier
fields.description: The application bundle identifier of the application that opens the URL. To use this property, install the profile through MDM. Available in iOS 14 and later.

fields.name: static-apps
fields.title: Static Apps
fields.description: An array of items located on the Applications side of the Dock and cannot be removed from that location.

fields.name: static-others

fields.name: persistent-apps

fields.name: persistent-others

fields.name: tilesize
fields.title: Size
fields.description: The tile size. Values must be in the range from 16 to 128.

fields.name: size-immutable

fields.description: If 'true', locks the size slider.

fields.name: magnification

fields.description: If 'true', enables magnification.

fields.description: The size of the largest magnification.

fields.name: magsize-immutable

fields.name: orientation

fields.name: position-immutable
fields.title: Position on screen buttons disabled
fields.description: If 'true', locks the position.

fields.name: mineffect

fields.name: mineffect-immutable
fields.title: Minimize window effect button disabled
fields.description: If 'true', locks "Minimize windows using."

fields.name: minimize-to-application
fields.title: Minimize windows into application icon
fields.description: If 'true', enables "Minimize windows into application icon."

fields.name: minintoapp-immutable
fields.title: Minimize windows into application icon Checkbox Disable
fields.description: If 'true', disables the "Minimize windows into application icon" checkbox.

fields.name: launchanim
fields.title: Animate opening applications
fields.description: If 'true', enables "Animate opening applications."

fields.name: launchanim-immutable
fields.title: Animate opening applications checkbox disabled
fields.description: If 'true', locks "Animate opening applications."

fields.name: autohide
fields.title: Automatically hide and show the Dock
fields.description: If 'true', enables "Automatically hide and show the Dock."

fields.name: autohide-immutable
fields.title: Automatically hide and show the Dock checkbox disabled
fields.description: If 'true', locks "Automatically hide."

fields.name: show-process-indicators
fields.title: Show indicators for open applications
fields.description: If true, shows the process indicator.

fields.name: show-recents
fields.title: Show recent applications in Dock
fields.description: If 'true', enables "Show recent items."

fields.name: show-recent-count
fields.title: Number of recent applications
fields.description: Controls the number of items shown in the recent apps area of the dock.

fields.name: static-only
fields.title: Remove non-static apps and documents from Dock
fields.description: If 'true', uses the 'static-apps' and 'static-others' dictionaries for the Dock and ignores any items in the 'persistent-apps' and 'persistent-others' dictionaries. If 'false', the contents are merged with the static items listed first.

fields.name: contents-immutable
fields.title: Prevent modifying items in Dock
fields.description: If 'true', disables changes to the Dock.

fields.name: AllowDockFixupOverride
fields.title: Allow DockFixup override
fields.description: If 'true', use the file in '/Library/Preferences/com.apple.dockfixup.plist' when a new user or migrated user logs in. This option has no effect for existing users. Available in macOS 10.12 and later. Only available on the device channel.

fields.name: MCXDockSpecialFolders
fields.title: Managed Client Special Folders
fields.description: One or more special folders that may be created at user login time and placed in the Dock. The "My Applications" item is only used for Simple Finder environments. The "Original Network Home" item is only used for mobile account users.

fields.name: windowtabbing-immutable
fields.title: Prevent changing tabs preference

fields.name: dblclickbehavior
fields.title: Doubleclick behavior
fields.description: The behavior when the window's title bar is double-clicked.

fields.name: dblclickbehavior-immutable
fields.title: Prevent changing doubleclick behavior
fields.description: If 'true', locks "Double-click a window's title bar."

fields.name: showindicators-immutable
fields.title: Prevent changing indicators display
fields.description: If 'true', locks "Show indicators."

fields.name: showrecents-immutable
fields.title: Prevent shanging recents display
fields.description: If 'true', disables "Show recent applications" checkbox.

fields.name: AdminHostInfo
fields.title: Show additional information in the menu bar
fields.description: The admin host info. If present in the payload, the system displays its value in the Login Window as additional computer information. fields.name: LoginwindowText
fields.title: Banner
fields.description: The text to display in the Login Window.

fields.name: SHOWFULLNAME
fields.title: Display login window as
fields.description: If 'true', the system shows the name and password dialog. If 'false', the system displays a list of users.

fields.name: HideLocalUsers
fields.title: Show local users
fields.description: If 'true', the system shows only network and system users when showing a user list.

fields.name: HideMobileAccounts
fields.title: Show mobile accounts
fields.description: If 'true', the system hides mobile account users in a user list. In some cases, mobile users show up as network users.

fields.name: IncludeNetworkUser
fields.title: Show network users
fields.description: If 'true', the system shows network users when showing a user list.

fields.name: HideAdminUsers
fields.title: Show Mac computer's administrator accounts
fields.description: If 'true', the system hides administrator users when showing a user list.

fields.name: SHOWOTHERUSERS_MANAGED
fields.title: Show "Other"
fields.description: If 'true', the system displays "Other..." when it shows a list of users.

fields.name: SleepDisabled
fields.title: Show the Sleep button
fields.description: If 'true', the system disables the Sleep button.

fields.name: RestartDisabled
fields.title: Show the Restart button
fields.description: If 'true', the system disables the Restart item.

fields.name: ShutDownDisabled
fields.title: Show the Shut Down button
fields.description: If 'true', the system disables the Shut Down button.

fields.name: RestartDisabledWhileLoggedIn
fields.title: Disable the Restart menu item while logged in
fields.description: If 'true', the system disables the Restart menu item when the user is logged in.

fields.name: ShutDownDisabledWhileLoggedIn
fields.title: Disable the Shut Down menu item while logged in
fields.description: If 'true', the system disables the Shut Down menu item when the user is logged in.

fields.name: PowerOffDisabledWhileLoggedIn
fields.title: Disable the Power Off menu item while logged in
fields.description: If 'true', the system disables the Power Off menu item when the user is logged in.

fields.name: LogOutDisabledWhileLoggedIn
fields.title: Disable the Log Out menu item while logged in
fields.description: If 'true', the system disables the Log Out menu item when the user is logged in. Available in macOS 10.13 and later.

fields.name: DisableScreenLockImmediate
fields.title: Disable the immediate Screen Lock function
fields.description: If 'true', the system disables the immediate Screen Lock functions. Available in macOS 10.13 and later.

fields.name: com.apple.login.mcx.DisableAutoLoginClient
fields.title: Disable automatic login if FileVault is disabled
fields.description: A loginwindow password will be required to login.

fields.name: AutologinUsername
fields.title: AutologinUsername
fields.description: The user short name for an existing user to set up auto login.

fields.name: AutologinPassword
fields.title: AutologinPassword
fields.description: An optional user password to set up auto login. This must match the 'AutologinUsername' user's current password.

fields.name: DisableFDEAutoLogin
fields.title: Disable automatic login if FileVault is enabled
fields.description: If 'true', the system disables the automatic login option when using FileVault.

fields.name: DisableConsoleAccess
fields.title: Enable >console login
fields.description: If 'true', the system disregards the '>console' special user name, which provides a command line UI.

fields.name: EnableExternalAccounts
fields.title: Enable external accounts
fields.description: Allows external accounts to log in.

fields.name: AdminMayDisableMCX
fields.title: Mac computer administrators may refresh content or disable management
fields.description: Allows Mac administrators on the computer to refresh or disable the management features.

fields.name: TALLogoutSavesState
fields.title: Reopen windows when logging back in
fields.description: Reopens windows that were open at time of logout

fields.name: UseComputerNameForComputerRecordName
fields.title: Set Mac computer name to computer record name
fields.description: Forces the name of the Mac to be set as the computer record name.

fields.name: AllowList
fields.title: Allowed Users or Groups
fields.description: The list of user GUIDs or group GUIDs of users that the system allows to log in. An asterisk ('*') string specifies all users or groups. This only applies to network accounts and mobile accounts.

fields.name: DenyList
fields.title: Denied Users or Groups
fields.description: The list of user GUIDs or group GUIDs of users that the system disallows to log in. This list takes priority over the list in the 'AllowList' key. This only applies to network accounts and mobile accounts.

fields.name: LocalUserLoginEnabled
fields.title: Local-only users may log in
fields.description: Permit only local users to log in. Network users won't be allowed to log in.

fields.name: LocalUsersHaveWorkgroups
fields.title: Local-only users use available workgroup settings
fields.description: Local users are forced to use any available workgroup settings.

fields.name: FlattenUserWorkgroups
fields.title: Ignore workgroup nesting
fields.description: If users are part of a nested workgroup, only the settings of the user's workgroup are enforced.

fields.name: CombineUserWorkgroups
fields.title: Combine available workgroup settings
fields.description: If users are part of a nested workgroup, all nested workgroup settings are enforced.

fields.name: AlwaysShowWorkgroupDialog
fields.title: Always show workgroup dialog during log in
fields.description: If the workgroup has a specific dialog, that dialog is shown when users log in.

fields.name: ChangePasswordDisabled
fields.title: Allow user to change password
fields.description: Enable or disable the "Change Password…" button in the Users & Groups preference pane.

fields.name: RetriesUntilHint
fields.title: Show password hints after failed attempts
fields.description: Number of tries until password hint is shown (0 = disable password hints).

fields.name: showInputMenu
fields.title: Show input menu in login window
fields.description: If 'true', the system shows the Input Menu in the Login Window.

fields.name: HiddenUsersList
fields.title: Hidden Users List
fields.description: Hides users defined in the list from the login window under the Other button

fields.name: CatalogURL
fields.title: Catalog URL
fields.description: The URL of the software update catalog. This property is not supported in macOS 11 and later.

fields.name: SUDisableEVCheck
fields.title: Disable Extended Validation check of TLS certificate.
fields.description: This option was needed during Mojave betas which required https.

fields.name: AutomaticCheckEnabled
fields.title: Automatically check for updates
fields.description: If 'false', deselects the "Check for updates" option and prevents the user from changing the option.

fields.name: AutomaticDownload
fields.title: Download newly available updates in the background
fields.description: If 'false', deselects the "Download new updates when available from the App Store" option and prevents the user from changing the option.

fields.name: AutomaticallyInstallMacOSUpdates
fields.title: Automatically install macOS updates
fields.description: If 'false', restricts the "Install macOS Updates" option and prevents the user from changing the option.

fields.name: AutomaticallyInstallAppUpdates
fields.title: Automatically install App Store app updates
fields.description: If 'false', deselects the "Install app updates from the App Store" option and prevents the user from changing the option.

fields.name: ConfigDataInstall
fields.title: Install XProtect, MRT, & Gatekeeper updates automatically
fields.description: If 'false', restricts the automatic installation of configuration data.

fields.name: CriticalUpdateInstall
fields.title: Install security updates automatically
fields.description: If 'false', disables the automatic installation of critical updates and prevents the user from changing the "Install system data files and security updates" option.

fields.name: AllowPreReleaseInstallation
fields.title: Allow Pre-Release Update Installation
fields.description: If 'true', prerelease software can be installed on this computer.

fields.name: forceDelayedSoftwareUpdates
fields.title: Force Update Delay
fields.description: Software updates will be delayed by the duration defined by ManagedDeferredInstallDelay.

fields.name: restrict-software-update-require-admin-to-install
fields.title: Restrict app installations to admin users
fields.description: If 'true', restrict app installations to admin users. This key has the same function as the 'restrict-store-require-admin-to-install' key in the 'com.apple.appstore' payload.

fields.name: ManagedDeferredInstallDelay
fields.title: Update Delay
fields.description: The duration that software updates will be delayed. (Days)

fields.name: NotificationSettings
fields.title: Notification Settings
